offences.quote: As a general rule, the unauthorised use of or consultation with generative AI technologies by undergraduate students and postgraduate students enrolled in coursework degrees to substantially complete any component of their coursework shall be treated as potential academic misconduct under the Student Academic Integrity Regulation.

definitions.quote: Examples of generative AI technologies include ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini and other similar systems used for producing text, images, or other content.
